A newline inside two nested spans after an emphasis still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p><i>Alpha</i><span><span>\n</span></span>Beta</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
